result:
Round 228 (CALM-1b) passes my independent check. I found no bugs. Every browser check in the task ran in real Chromium on `/studio-lab` at 1440×900 and 1280×720, starting from a fresh anonymous visit, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true.

**What I confirmed:**
- **Scope:** HEAD is `d32464e`. Only the 12 granted files changed (all modified, no new files). The frozen, root and A's end-hash lists match. The protected auth and purchase files are unchanged. The test edits are the allowed title swaps plus A's new cases SC5, ST-K1 and NS5.
- **Unit tests:** the 4 named test files pass (108 tests), and SC5, ST-K1 and NS5 exist.
- **Tooltips:** each transport button's title is byte-exact in every state, e.g. "Back to start (Home)", "Undo: Add Marker (Ctrl+Z)", "Redo: Add Marker (Ctrl+Shift+Z)", "Pause (Space)" while playing. The Fit title has the new wording.
- **`aria-keyshortcuts`:** the 7 values match the task table exactly. Z, X and the footer button keep theirs, and Fit and Follow have none. Accessible names are unchanged.
- **Tooltips match the sheet:** with no time selection and after one edit, the key named in each title is the key the open shortcut sheet shows (0 mismatches). Snap, Envelope and the marker buttons also match.
- **The keys work:** Home goes to 00:00, Space plays and stops, Ctrl+E splits, and Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z and Ctrl+Y undo and redo. Delete leaves a gap, and Ctrl+L turns the loop on. Holding Ctrl+L toggles only once, and after clicking Delete, focus moves to Undo.
- **Shortcut sheet:** 43/43 rows match. The new Fit key fits on one line at 1280, and search results equal round 227's plus "time selection" now finding Fit. `?`, the footer button and Esc open and close it, and focus returns to the button.
- **Layout and screen budget:** no element moved more than 1 px compared with round 227, and the footer text is identical.
- **Auth guard:** a fresh visitor sees the demo with no sign-in, the protected `/studio/middle-east` page asks to sign in and loads no audio, and the Studio token API refuses access (401 with no header, 500 with a fake token).
- **Export:** the WAV is 24-bit, 48 kHz, stereo, 101.352 s, and its loudness per segment is identical to round 227.
- **Doc 177 and the Ableton reference:** the doc's status line and test lists are correct and every cited id exists. I fetched the Live 12 shortcut page and the MDN `aria-keyshortcuts` page today. They confirm the key names and the attribute syntax. Showing the key in a hover tooltip and writing "Ctrl" instead of "Ctrl/Cmd" are recorded, intended differences from Live.

**Not covered:**
- The full test suite, build, `verify` and the e2e smoke run belong to the root gate.
- The Mac (Cmd) versions of the keys can't be tested here and are left for a manual check on a Mac.
- Headless Chromium draws no native tooltip on hover, which the task allows; the title attribute itself is correct.

**Notes for B, none of them bugs:**
- A's code reviewer pointed out that "Ctrl" alone no longer hints at ⌘ for Mac users. That is B's own ruling (D-29z279), so I didn't file it.
- When a time selection is active, the Delete title ends with "…Ctrl+Shift+X" rather than a key in brackets. The task excludes that state on purpose, so nobody needs to re-check it.
- The exported WAV peaks at full scale (30 samples), exactly as in round 227, so this round didn't cause it.

I made no source changes and no commits.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-228.md`
- `c-round-228.json`
- `c-round-228/` (scripts, screenshots, measurements)
